In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="SoD Date" /> the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] launched a '''war''' against the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]] led by the rogue [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] following his escape from a [[Spire (Stygeon Prime)/Legends|Separatist prison]] on the planet [[Stygeon/Legends|Stygeon]].<ref name="Son of Dathomir 1" /> The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] became involved during a [[Assault on Vizsla Keep 09|battle]] within a [[Mandalorian asteroid outpost/Legends|Mandalorian asteroid outpost]].<ref name="Son of Dathomir 3" /> The war ended with the death of [[Nightsisters|Nightsister]] [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] and the disbandment of the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]].<ref name="Son of Dathomir 4" />
